meta.title: AI and lawyers in Kazakhstan: what changes
meta.description: Which legal tasks AI handles well, where it falls short, why Kazakhstan sources matter, what Law No. 230-VIII says and how legal teams can adopt AI.
meta.excerpt: AI takes over the first pass of research, document review and drafting. Judgement and responsibility stay with the lawyer. Tasks, sources, the AI law, skills and a step-by-step adoption plan.

postYuristAi.title: AI and the legal profession in Kazakhstan: what changes and what does not
postYuristAi.lead: AI already searches, summarises and drafts. It does not sign the advice. What changes for lawyers in Kazakhstan, what stays the same, and what the Law “On Artificial Intelligence” says.

cta.title: See how AI works with Kazakhstan law
cta.text: Bring a real question to the demo. We will show how the Assistant cites Kazakhstan legislation, how review tables keep the source behind every answer, and how your lawyers stay in control of the result.
